records.deidentified_narrative: unit 1 driver (u1d) said she was turning left from mt calvary to head north on the [roadway]. u1d said she had the green light and was awaiting a via bus coming from exeter [roadway] heading southbound. as u1d turned left she heard and felt as if she struck something with unit 1 (u1). u1d turned u1 back to the intersection and talked with ped1, who was at the bus stop. u1d asked if she saw anything she may have hit. per u1d, ped1 raised her hand and told u1d she was hit in the arm. ped1 did not specify which arm. at the angle of where u1d placed u1 and ped1, ped1 may have been struck on the left arm. u1d said she asked ped1 if she was okay. u1d said her driver's mirror broke off at impact. u1d said she picked up the mirror off the roadway. ped1 told u1d she was and u1d left the location. u1d said she told her uncle about the incident who told her to return to the accident scene and call the police to report it. when u1d returned ped1 was no longer at the bus stop. as i looked over u1, the driver's side mirror was missing, red particle transfer was on the fender/hood near the mirror, and red fabric transfer was found on the black broken piece that was still attached to the door. at approximately 1117 hrs (refer to cfs # sapd-2019-0098009), [medical facility] due to her left arm hurting. officer t. martin #[medical facility]. ped1 said she was involved in an accident at the accident location. officer martin said ped1 was awaiting x-rays but at this time the left arm was swollen. officer martin said she provided u1d's information and this [case id].
